Over the session protocol, resuming a session the host still has loaded after its log was deleted or replaced outside Muse now refuses with a message that says so and how to go on, instead of answering that the session was not found or resuming it as if its log were intact

When /feedback or /bug cannot upload because there is no Model API key, the message now says how to get the report sent: set a Model API key so /feedback can send it, or, as a Meta employee, use the internal Muse build
Workflow workers no longer get a background-command reminder queued while their turn is still running, which could stop them from submitting their result
A hosted session no longer skips a compaction checkpoint after a subagent's write to the same session file recovers from a disk error
Code blocks inside quotes keep their indentation and highlighting, and their fence lines no longer show
Through `muse serve` and the SDKs, stopping a subagent that another subagent started now stops it instead of failing
Avoid a false active work warning when quitting a resumed fork

A periodic context save that fails, for example on a storage error, no longer ends the turn; the save is skipped with a note of why and the turn goes on, and a save whose cleanup of older history fails still counts as saved
After a crash, a `!` command that had not finished is marked cancelled with a note that it may have run, instead of an empty result

When queued background work cannot be started, the failure is now written to the local diagnostics that `/feedback` sends, and to the terminal outside the full-screen view, instead of being silently dropped

A chat keeps the name saved in its own history when you open it, even if Muse's separate list of names has lost it; before, it could get a new automatic name and `muse resume <name>` stopped finding it
Truncated shell output keeps its correct total size when output arrives slowly
Over the session protocol, resuming a session that a client had left with `session/leave` no longer reports that its last run ended abnormally
Sandboxed hooks and commands no longer fail at random with "Can't find source path" when another sandboxed process in the same session starts or exits
Stopping a paused workflow now still reports the stop after Muse restarts
On macOS, pasting a screenshot with Cmd+V now attaches it in terminals that send an empty paste for images, such as VS Code and Cursor

Right after an upgrade, `muse attach <session-name>` now waits for the session index to finish reading session names (it prints "indexing session names after an upgrade..." while it waits, as `muse resume <name>` does) instead of refusing that the session-name authority is unavailable; before, every retry refused the same way

Reading a forked or rewound conversation over the session protocol now shows the messages you sent in its copied turns that were missing before: each message of a turn that began with several, a message with an image, and a message you sent while the original turn was still working
Terminals that show program status (OSC 7501) now see Muse as waiting for you when a quick turn ends on a plain-text question before Muse confirms your message, instead of done

A long `muse exec` session that resumes for every prompt no longer stops saving its checkpoints after a few thousand prompts, because every session now drops the records of prompts that the conversation summary has already replaced
Clarify guidance to decode Workflow report fields before quoting them verbatim, keep literal escapes, and place commentary outside the quote
During the five seconds that a hook's block, failure or timeout notice shows in the lower-right corner, another hook's message no longer replaces it and is not shown
After Muse Code restarts from a crash, messages you queued before the crash now run before your next message, once each and in the order you sent them; before, your new message ran first

With a goal reminder active, a background command the agent stopped itself (or saw finish while checking on it) no longer counts as still running, so the reminder can send the agent back to unfinished work instead of leaving the session idle with nothing left to wake it
Apps connected to `muse serve --listen` now get the `session/started` notification before the reply to `session/start`, the same order as over stdio
A subagent whose definition declares memory no longer stops with a memory error partway through its work, and it now saves its context when its history is compacted, so reopening it stays fast
A paused workflow now stays resumable after Muse restarts even when a context compaction happens before any session checkpoint

When Muse asks a clarifying question, the recommended option now keeps the full scope you asked for instead of offering a reduced or skeleton variant, and on a request that already settles the outcome it proceeds without stopping to ask
Restore missing Workflow failure notifications when a child start cannot be confirmed
Rewind works in forked conversations, including copied messages and new messages added after the fork
After a crash during automatic naming, a chat whose history already holds its name keeps that name on the next start instead of getting a new automatic one

In `muse serve`, when a busy session has not started a message within 30 seconds, the message is now withdrawn with a busy error you can retry, instead of an internal error after which it could still run later
`muse exec` with a model already chosen no longer exits when the model catalog service answers with no models; it prints one notice and runs that model
A `muse exec` session that resumes for every prompt no longer adds a record per prompt to every saved checkpoint, which made such sessions stop saving checkpoints after a few thousand prompts
`/stop all` in a subagent's thread now stops that subagent's own running subagents instead of reporting the stop as failed
A `muse serve` chat that an older Muse version still holds open now shows its saved history when its log had an unreadable stretch, instead of showing no history

When you resume a session and its log is deleted or replaced outside Muse before Muse saves anything new to it, Muse now tells you what happened to it instead of quietly starting a new log or writing into the replacement. A session log or folder moved away outside Muse is no longer re-created empty, so moving it back keeps saving in the same place

When the model catalog lists no visible model, Muse now starts on the newest hidden model it grants you and names it in a startup notice, instead of stopping with "model catalog has no visible models"
After a crash, a question the agent was still waiting on can be answered even when earlier work in the session was compacted

After a model switch makes a chat unable to continue, Muse now says why and that starting a new session continues the work with this session's history kept, instead of only saying the turn could not prepare the conversation
A session started by a newer Muse no longer disappears from session lists while an older Muse process keeps running on the same machine

A session whose first prompt is very large, for example a log file of several megabytes, no longer drops out of the session list in apps that list your sessions, and you can still resume it and send more prompts; the session title shows the first 1,000 characters of that prompt
A prompt queued through the session protocol while a finished turn's follow-up waits to start now reports its own turn, so a client that waits on that turn gets its answer
Subscriber sessions no longer fail with "Model not found" when the model list arrives after sign-in
When a Workflow finishes after its script handled a failed agent call, Muse no longer tells the agent that the Workflow failed, so the agent no longer reports a finished Workflow as failed
When a long thread goes over the model's context window, the automatic smaller retry now drops enough older messages to fit instead of being refused again
After a session storage error clears, a Workflow agent that already finished no longer shows as scheduled or running again when the Workflow settles
Skill reminders no longer steer the agent onto a different skill when a skill it already loaded covers the same step
`muse mcp login` works after adding the first server to a fresh config
Fixed re-loading a chat's failed view while a tool streams output, which could fail with `projectionRebuildFailed`

Stopping a turn over the session protocol while a shell command's second permission ask is open, after you allowed the first one, no longer makes every later prompt in that session fail with "approval replay failed" or stay queued

`muse attach <session>` from a terminal to a session a `muse serve` host is running now says at once that a terminal can't join it yet and to keep using the window that runs it, instead of opening the resume picker and reporting the session as already in use

A chat whose automatic compaction keeps failing at the context limit no longer pays for a new summary on every request; after 2 failures in a row, Muse stops automatic compaction for that chat until a compaction works or you reopen it, and `/compact` still works

A session whose recent turns hold many full-size images, such as dozens of screenshots, can still be resumed after its context fills up; before, the compaction that followed could leave the session impossible to resume. If automatic compaction stops because those images make the compacted context too big to save, the stop notice now says so
Resuming a chat no longer repeats subagent completion messages or shows new child work as finished
When you report that a change does not show up in your own run, the agent is now prompted to trace the code path you ran instead of stopping at setup or flag steps
When a reminder such as a goal keeps a turn going after its answer and you press Esc while Muse is thinking again, the answer now shows Interrupted under it
A session no longer skips a compaction checkpoint when a Goal turn ended while its Workflow kept running and later finished
Forking a chat that contains an empty turn whose start was not recorded is now refused with a message saying why, instead of creating a fork that fails to open

In a compacted session, an image prompt that you send after you reopen the session now stays in the model's context after the next reopen, and `/compact` works again in that session; you cannot yet rewind to that turn or fork from it
IDE and other session-protocol clients now show the same warning as the terminal when a paused workflow is left out of a saved context checkpoint (`NoticeOrigin` gains `workflowCheckpoint`)
A prompt with an image is no longer dropped when the context is compacted at the start of its turn, so the agent answers that prompt instead of the previous one
A fork whose seed would fail to load elsewhere is now refused at creation with a clear error instead of publishing and then failing to open
Fixed a race where re-loading a chat's failed view during a running turn could fail with `projectionRebuildFailed`

A `session/resume` check (`admitOnly: true`) no longer makes the checking client a driver of the session, sends `session/driveChanged` (experimental) to its other clients, or re-sends it the session's pending approval and user-input requests; a `session/resume` without `admitOnly` still joins the session's drivers, as before
In `muse serve`, leaving a chat that another connected client is driving no longer stops and unloads it under that client: `session/leave` answers `sessionInUse` and the chat stays loaded

Aborting `Session.run` in the TypeScript and Python SDKs while its turn is still queued and the host is busy now keeps taking the turn back, so the turn no longer runs after the abort; in Python, cancelling again returns at once while the take-back still finishes
A Workflow resume that stops because an agent's saved start record is damaged now reports the plain reason and next step in its result and in the Latest error row, not only an error code

The "session log flush degraded" note at the end of a turn no longer goes missing when a queued message or a model, approval or reasoning-effort change was refused once because a save had failed earlier in the turn
The first message you send after an automatic compaction finishes in the background now builds on its summary, instead of requesting another summary and dropping the recent turn that summary kept
Through `muse serve` and the SDKs, a subagent that was interrupted and resumed no longer shows its earlier run's late result as its own while the new run is working
Branching a forked or side session right after it compacts, before its next message, no longer fails with a fork seed count mismatch

A session running Workflows no longer gets stuck unable to save its context when a Workflow capacity record has lost its launch record; that one Workflow can no longer resume its children after a restart, and the session keeps saving and continuing
Preserve subagent Stop information when reopening a chat
After a crash, a subagent's earlier turns show a monitor's own recorded end (ended, timed out, or failed with its reason) instead of `stopped` when the monitor finished just before the crash
The queued input panel no longer says "your input still works" when message updates fail
Workflow scripts preserve their complete return value, including partial status and remaining work
Rewinding to a turn whose pasted image can't be read now says the image couldn't be read and that you can retry, instead of saying the conversation changed
Resuming a session after two or more successful `/compact` runs no longer shows a false "runtime closed before context compaction completed" warning
In a long `/goal` session, pausing, editing or otherwise changing the goal while Muse compacts the conversation no longer leaves that compaction without a resume point
Resume paused Workflows while preserving completed child results
A compaction no longer skips its checkpoint when a tool result was saved to the run but not to the session log

The built-in `browser-game` skill finishes games built from long design documents faster: the first critic plays the game as soon as it runs, before the art is in, and the second and third critic rounds play the same copy at the same time

When a background task's status can no longer be read (for example, a finished subagent whose session log is gone), the TUI stops retrying it several times a second, so an idle session no longer keeps a CPU core busy
Resuming a long session without a saved checkpoint no longer opens one background thread per finished shell command, so memory and startup work no longer grow with the session's command history
Resuming a long session no longer scrolls the whole history through the terminal; it shows the newest part that fits the terminal's scrollback, with a note that earlier conversation is not shown
An idle session no longer holds a CPU core while an older Muse Code version runs on the same machine; the two versions no longer keep rebuilding each other's saved-session list
Long-running sessions use less memory while the session list refreshes its index of large past sessions
Resuming a long session recorded by an older version uses less memory, because model instructions and context settings repeated on every run are kept once instead of once per run
Resuming a long session uses less memory, because background-task and subagent records read back from the session log are no longer kept twice
Resuming a long session uses less memory, because the subagent view no longer keeps its own copy of every past event
Resuming a session with finished subagents uses less memory, because reading a subagent's task state no longer keeps that subagent's whole conversation loaded
An open session that has run subagents or workflows uses less memory, because an unused second copy of their admission records is no longer kept
Resumed sessions with compaction checkpoints use less memory
Rebuilding the session list after an update uses much less peak memory, because large sessions are no longer read at the same time
A session that has run many subagents or workflows uses less memory, because each small per-task record list keeps only the slots it uses
Refreshing the session list's index of a large past session that has no checkpoint uses less memory
A long session uses less memory as it runs, because model instructions and context settings that stay the same between turns are kept once instead of once per turn
Resumed long sessions use less memory, because each kept run event is stored once instead of once in the run history and again in the model context view
A session that runs commands with a lot of output uses less memory, because Muse Code now keeps each piece of command output once in memory instead of three times
When a long-running background task wakes the agent only to report that it is still running, the agent now ends that check quietly instead of making an extra model call to write a summary
Resuming a long session uses much less memory, because the session log's records are no longer kept a second time to prove their original bytes
Resuming a long session uses less peak memory
`muse serve` spends less CPU per loaded session while idle, and creating a session stays cheap with many sessions loaded
Resuming a long session that has no saved checkpoint needs much less peak memory while it loads, because each line of the session log is no longer held twice
Resuming a long session with many finished background tasks uses less memory, because each finished task's recent output lines are kept once instead of twice
A resumed long session holds less memory while it stays open
Creating a session writes its scheduled-task store with fewer disk flushes, so bursts of new sessions in `muse serve` finish sooner
A resumed long session uses less memory, because the task and run state kept for later appends no longer copies records the session already holds
Resuming a long session keeps less memory, because the live session log no longer holds a spare buffer sized for every record
A long session uses less memory, because the index that matches recorded copies of run and approval events keeps each copy once
A resumed session uses less memory, because the replay check it keeps for later checkpoints no longer holds a copy of every queued message
Long sessions grow more slowly in memory, because each new session record is no longer kept a second time to prove its original bytes
Paging through a long session's retained history no longer reads the whole file into memory before decoding it; each line is decoded as it is read
Long sessions use less memory, because every recorded step of a run takes less space in memory
Long sessions that run workflows use less memory, because a workflow subagent that fails or ends without a result no longer stays loaded after the workflow reads its outcome
Long sessions that run workflows or subagents use less memory, because the workflow view now keeps only each agent's tool calls and token usage instead of its whole run
Long sessions that run workflows or subagents use less memory, because a finished subagent's conversation is no longer kept loaded after it was last read
In a long chat, Muse sends your message sooner after you press Enter: the work before each request no longer repeats once for every installed skill, so it stays close to a fresh chat's
`session/read` shows which connected client currently drives a session (`driveHolder`, the holder's `initialize` name and version; absent when nobody live holds it)
A failed turn's error now carries `requestDenied: true` when the provider refused the request, so session protocol clients can show "Request denied" instead of a generic model failure
Permission profiles can now allow, prompt for, or deny Unix-socket access per path, and a refused Docker socket connection explains the sandbox block with the way out
Startup names the effective approval mode when `--yolo` was requested but a restrictive permission profile took effect

`session/read`, `session/list` and the `session/resume` result show which client last resumed a session over the wire (`resumedByClient`, the resuming connection's `initialize` name and version, recorded durably on the resume marker)
`session/resume` accepts an optional `modelId` that overrides the retained model for that resume — over a stamped label or pin — and recovers an otherwise-unresolved label binding
`session/start` accepts an optional `previousSessionId` that records which session the new one replaces, even when that session no longer exists
Settings-listed models can name a separate background model for reminders and reviews
When the approval judge escalates to you instead of deciding, the approval card now shows the judge's reason as one short line under the command, so a risky request is harder to approve by reflex

`session/list`, `session/read` and the `session/resume` result show which session opened a worker session (`spawnedBy`: the opening session's id plus optional project and thread labels, recorded once when the worker's first session starts)

`session/start` accepts an optional `spawnedBy` (the opening session's id plus optional project and thread labels); the host records it once as the new session's opener and serves it back as `spawnedBy` on `session/list`, `session/read` and `session/resume`

`muse session-message list --json` rows carry `spawnedBy`, the session that opened each listed worker session (its id plus optional project and thread labels), read from the same session index `session/list` serves
An older Muse build cannot open a chat whose permissions were reset because part of its saved permission history was lost or damaged; update the app to open it (other chats are unaffected)
`muse serve --preset` applies the preset's prompts and run settings, accepts presets defined with `-c`, and keeps the preset chosen at startup after login
New features in a project the agent built earlier in the same session no longer start with a failing test, and reported bugs still get a regression test

Inside tmux, Muse now reports its program status (OSC 7501) without waiting for the terminal to answer, so iTerm2's tmux integration (`tmux -CC`) shows whether a session is working, waiting for you, or done; a client that attaches later sees it once the attach resizes the window or the status next changes
Permission profiles that prompt before socket access keep prompting after a session is reopened, and opening such a session requires the latest app version
When an answer compares several things in a table, the detail that does not fit the table now comes as short paragraphs or list items instead of one long block per item
Resume checkpoints of long sessions no longer keep every finished Workflow's child-capacity records, so they stay smaller; opening a session compacted this way needs this app version or later
When Muse Code double-checks its work after giving a final answer, it now reports the result of the check in a sentence or two instead of repeating or extending the answer
Long `/goal` sessions that start sub-agents keep their resume checkpoints small and resume quickly, instead of carrying every step since the first sub-agent started
When you ask for a plan in a file and say what the chat reply should contain, Muse Code saves the plan and replies only as you asked
Overviews, explanations, comparisons, and answers in a format you asked for no longer open with a top-finding line; reports on work Muse Code did still lead with the main finding

When branching a conversation through `muse serve` fails because a session file could not be written, the error now names the step that failed, the kind of path and the operating-system error instead of only `WriteFailed`
`initialize` now refuses a `clientInfo.name` longer than 64 characters, with the same `invalidParams` error a malformed name already gets
Compaction checkpoints keep rejected commands in a smaller form; chats whose checkpoint holds one require a compatible app update, and older versions cannot open them
`/feedback` shows how big the session record is before you agree to attach it, and notes when it will be trimmed

The built-in `browser-game` skill builds games from long design documents with an art-director subagent, which makes the art and ships it in the game folder while the game is built, then runs three critic rounds that play and review the game; short game requests stay light
Apps that show tool activity now see a tool call while a pre-tool hook is still deciding on it, marked as held
When a task gives a reference image, the Blender skill now runs a required critic loop of blind reviews and fixes, as a workflow where available, so renders match the reference more closely
Models that support max reasoning effort now use it by default when you have not chosen an effort, including future models

Reopening a compacted session through `muse serve` (`session/read`, or `session/resume` when it returns inline or snapshot history) now shows the earlier conversation as one collapsed earlierHistory item holding the checkpoint's recent messages, followed by what came after, instead of replaying history from before the checkpoint. Clients that do not know the item kind show its fallback line
Security: Sandboxed Linux commands can no longer rewrite kernel helper settings under `/proc/sys`, even when Muse itself runs as root
A follow-up task sent to a subagent that finished before `muse serve` restarted no longer stops before reaching the model when MCP servers are configured
After a brief disk error interrupts one background save, the next save on the same chat clears it and goes through, instead of being refused until restart
A session waiting on a finished background task now wakes when the task finishes instead of staying stuck until you intervene

When a background context summary fails or is too large to use, Muse Code no longer pays for a new one every turn; it retries only after the conversation has grown well past the failed attempt, including after the session is reopened
Restore resume for older Side chats while preserving their history and permission settings
Preserve active tasks when compacting a conversation more than once
While a storage error lasts, a periodic save that has to be skipped no longer ends the turn when the note recording the skip cannot be written either; the error is logged and the turn goes on
Resuming a session saved by an older version no longer offers Workflow; start a new session to use it
`/new` or `/clear` right after cancelling a run no longer exits with a missing-file error
On Windows, sandboxed shell commands now start in the workspace when it is inside your user folder, so relative paths no longer resolve under the PowerShell install folder
On Windows, Ctrl+V pastes copied text into the prompt in consoles that pass the key to Muse, such as the classic PowerShell window, instead of reporting that no image could be attached
Forking a chat with `muse serve` on Linux works again instead of failing with "file birth time is unavailable"

The `game-3d-visuals` skill now stops its pipeline loop when you ask it to stop, open the file or change course: "open it" opens the file (or says it is not ready yet) instead of waiting for the running stage, and a comment such as "thanks" lets the pipeline continue
Fixed workflow instructions that did not match the current session
A sub-agent started from a `/goal` chat saves its history again when it compacts, so it can be resumed from that point
The built-in `python-env` skill tries a container image, conda channel or prebuilt wheels that the user or the project names before compiling a dependency from source

A chat in which one record of a turn could not be written to disk, even after a retry (for example on a full disk that stayed full), can be forked, side-chatted and rewound again; that turn is left out of the new chat, and Muse says so once
Resumed sessions with a recorded selection keep the model you selected instead of switching to a default
After resuming a compacted session, follow-ups and waits on a subagent no longer fail once a shell command ran after the compaction
Reopening a chat whose saved view fell behind, for example after a cancelled turn, shows its latest turn instead of an older one
A subagent's transcript that a restart cut off reads again as soon as its parent session resumes, with no action on the subagent
Sessions where an older Muse Code (1.4.5 or earlier) recovered an interrupted workflow save context checkpoints again, so compaction is no longer skipped or dropped in them

A forked chat whose saved history has an unreadable part, and where the start of one of its own turns could not be written to disk, no longer refuses every message after it is reopened, forked or side-chatted; that turn is left out, and Muse says so once
A session saves its history again when it compacts after a Workflow's agents were skipped or retried more than 128 times, so it can be resumed from that point
Background work status survives a restart after correcting a missing Workflow name
A session with a lost permission change now refuses to resume when its safe permission reset cannot be enforced, instead of opening with silently dropped Deny rules
A chat in the app or `muse serve` that was closed while a workflow was running saves its history again after it is reopened

When you tell the `game-3d-visuals` skill to stop or exit while its pipeline runs, it now also stops the running background stage (unless you ask it not to call any tools), and a stage that finishes after you stopped no longer starts the next one
Stopping a background task or Monitor from `/tasks` just as it finishes now records the stop right away instead of dropping it after a 30-second wait

A chat in which a reminder for one turn could not be written to disk, even after a retry, can be forked and side-chatted again; that turn is left out of the new chat, and Muse says so once. Rewinding such a chat is still refused
Rewinding past a message you sent while the agent was busy no longer leaves the new branch stuck refusing every message and showing that message as still queued
Resuming a compacted session with `tbh exec --session-id` keeps its subagents, so following up with, waiting on or checking a subagent no longer reports it missing
Keep unknown Workflow result references unchanged
Complete Workflow reports remain readable when their preview is shortened
MCP servers start again when you resume a session after it was compacted, instead of every turn failing with "MCP startup audit failed" or the MCP tools going missing

A forked chat whose copied checkpoint can no longer be replayed (written by an older build, or slightly damaged) opens, forks and side-chats again with its copied history rebuilt; only history that truly cannot be read is left out, and Muse says so once
A Workflow paused just as it finishes now stays paused, instead of also reporting a finished result after the pause
A deactivated Muse Code app now names the server reason instead of telling the user to log in again
`muse serve` refuses to reopen a session whose automated reviewer this host cannot prepare with the `permission_profile_reviewer_unavailable` reason instead of a generic internal error
A chat in which a reminder for one turn could not be written to disk, even after a retry, can be rewound again; that turn is left out of the new chat, and Muse says so once
When a full disk could not save a task link, a monitor line or, in most cases, a named workflow launch, compaction checkpoints now keep working without restarting the chat

Cancelling, force-sealing or stopping a subagent whose own background work is still being killed no longer reports it done early: the result arrives once that work has ended, a cancel that cannot finish yet fails with a typed error naming the task, a stop answers `stopping` until then and is recorded once the jobs are dead
After a resumed session, following up with a subagent started before the conversation was compacted works again instead of failing the subagent with a missing ownership error
A chat in which two different kinds of record could not be written to disk can be forked and side-chatted again; both turns are left out of the new chat, and Muse says so once for each
Restore native MP4 and MOV video reading for supported models
Sessions with an earlier video read keep working when the current model, provider or video setting can't send that video
A denied cross-origin redirect no longer replaces the stored session for an Agent plugin's MCP server, and redirect grants no longer match non-HTTP(S) origins
Reopening a session no longer fails when a turn after a compaction reuses rules or instructions from before it
Background task output now wakes a waiting session instead of staying queued until you intervene
Resuming a session whose worktree was deleted now recreates it on hosts without an enforceable creation sandbox when you already trust the source repository; untrusted repositories still refuse
Built-in skills the model loads on its own now name tools the way the model is offered them, so it calls them by the right name

A session started by another app now takes its title and first-prompt preview from the prompt as it was shown, not the app's wrapper text, so it no longer appears with raw JSON as its name; a session that starts with a skill or image is titled by its display form (its typed form, or [Image 1] for an image-only start)
Saved Workflows can run again from their local script paths on Windows
Agent no longer repeats a question you already answered in the same conversation
Keep recovery guidance intact in long background Workflow results
Preserve the specific failure reason when a subagent fails

A chat reopened on an older build, whose log saved two background-result notices at the same spot, keeps saving compaction checkpoints in the running process instead of refusing them until the next reopen

In the terminal app, resuming a chat whose saved history lost a record after your last permission change (without a permission flag) now reopens it with a reset to the narrower of the default and your surviving profile — or to `:read-only` when the two are crossed — and a warning, instead of refusing it; a resume with no safely-resettable profile is still refused
Resuming a `muse serve` session after Muse Code exited unexpectedly no longer shows the interrupted run's work as still in progress
After a session reopens from a compacted history, retrying an approval decision, a question answer or a queued-message removal returns the original result instead of handling it again

After a crash, `muse serve` no longer asks again about tool calls that were waiting for approval and no longer runs an approved call by itself; the interrupted calls are closed and a call the model makes again gets the normal permission check
Branching a conversation on Windows no longer fails with a write error
When more skills are installed than the startup skill list can show, the agent can still find the ones left out by looking one up with part of its name or description
Plugin MCP servers approved in review can now sign in through `muse serve` as well as `muse mcp login`, instead of being refused as plugin-managed

Retrying a workflow child skip or retry with the same command id after a restart returns its original result; chats whose checkpoint holds such a result require a compatible app update, and older versions cannot open them
Recovered Workflow children release unused capacity reservations, and conflicting attempts get a clear restart error
A resumed coordinator lane whose session takes a moment to redraw now still receives its handover brief and answers, instead of going silent
Reopening a subagent chat keeps replies from earlier work
Tell the main agent to read complete Workflow reports before answering from a shortened preview
A long run no longer fails with "Origin read requires valid checkpoint-suffix or origin-preserved full-replay authority" when a tool result's saved copy has to be re-written after context compaction
A long-running served chat whose earlier checkpoint was saved together with a compaction keeps saving checkpoints instead of refusing every one after a reopen
Very long sessions no longer stall while compacting a conversation too large to summarize at once
A finished background task now wakes a waiting session even when an earlier wake was lost

Work status checks now show a short work ID once instead of repeating the full ID in the header and the status card, and listing background work shows item labels when present (else a short work ID) instead of raw JSON
Preserve background command results in session history after a recording error
A background task that keeps running through several compactions no longer shows as invalid after you reopen the chat
A side chat reopened after it compacted no longer re-reads its whole history each turn, so damage in older history no longer stops it

In the terminal app, resuming a chat whose saved history lost a record with a permission flag (for example --permission-profile or --sandbox-network) now applies your chosen permissions as the `lost_record_reset` commit that drops pre-loss grants (after the reset, or in its place when the reset is not allowed), and one warning that your chosen permissions apply. A pick the retained managed pin refuses, or a reset `:read-only` cannot be shown never wider than both profiles, still refuses with no reset and no warning
Deleting `session-index.db` while Muse Code runs no longer makes the session list fail or crashes the app; the index is rebuilt with fresh files
Opening a side chat over the session protocol no longer intermittently reports the new session is already in use
A parent agent can now read a subagent's whole final answer instead of only its first 512 characters, so it no longer spawns extra agents just to read the rest
Compaction avoids copying preserved user messages into its automatic history notes
A model response whose tool-call signals disagree on the tool name or call id now retries that attempt instead of ending the whole run

After a crash, a resumed client's subagent rows no longer show a recovered child as running, and its child-view composer correctly reports the thread as read-only instead of attempting a send the host rejects
Rewinding to an earlier turn no longer fails after a compaction that ran while a finished background task's result was still waiting to be delivered
A fork or side chat that compacted no longer writes later checkpoints that hide the compaction, so its next resume still starts from the checkpoint

Compaction handoff summaries now preserve operational state-to-action triggers (standing duties with their exact command) verbatim, so a duty like starting a bot once an approval arrives survives context compaction instead of being summarized away

In a session resumed from a checkpoint, running `/goal set` while a turn was running could cancel the new goal turn and then refuse every later message with "Message not sent — saving failed"; the goal turn now starts and later messages go through
Muse is told when the permission mode changes mid-session, so it stops insisting it is still on the launch mode after switching to Unrestricted
Pasting an API key into a logged-out session now shows the contributor models in /model immediately, instead of only after a restart
After context compaction summarizes a skill body away, the skill reminder can offer that skill again instead of treating it as already read for the rest of the session
Resumed and long-running sessions use less memory, because saved copies of session records made mostly of structured data are kept as compact text instead of an expanded in-memory form
Long sessions use less memory, because each saved run event takes less space in memory
Resumed long sessions use less memory, because each run's model instructions and context settings are kept once in memory instead of being copied for every run
Resuming a session with subagents no longer re-reads a subagent's history from before its last compaction
Typing in long sessions with many subagent runs stays responsive, because the subagent tree no longer re-checks every delivered result against every run on each frame
An idle session no longer re-reads the whole session index every two seconds, which removes a constant background disk read on machines with many saved sessions
Resuming a long session that has many subagents and no saved context checkpoint is faster, because checking each subagent log for a checkpoint no longer parses every record

title.zh-TW: 查詢工作階段連線狀態，清楚標記目前操控者與開立來源
title.en: Query session connection status with clear labels for active controller and opener

body.zh-TW: 當你在多個終端機視窗或不同工具之間切換，容易搞不清楚特定對話正被哪端控制。⟦就像大型會議室門口的電子簽到看板，誰正握著麥克風發言、上一位交接者是誰，以及這場分組討論由哪個主會議指派，全都清清楚楚列在螢幕上。⟧現在讀取工作階段時，會透過 `driveHolder` 標記目前哪位客戶端正在即時操控。呼叫 `session/read`、`session/list` 或喚醒結果時，也會顯示 `resumedByClient` 記錄最後是誰重新連線。透過 `session/start` 建立新對話時，可帶入 `previousSessionId` 記錄它接替了哪場舊對話。若由主對話開立背景工作者，相關清單與指令 `muse session-message list --json` 也會附上 `spawnedBy` 標籤，每一列都會告訴你，是哪個工作階段開立了這個背景工作者。
body.en: When switching between multiple terminal windows or different tools, it is easy to lose track of which side currently controls a specific conversation. ⟦Picture an electronic sign-in board outside a large conference room that clearly displays on screen who holds the microphone, who handed it off last, and which main meeting assigned this breakout discussion.⟧ Now when reading a session, `driveHolder` marks which client is driving it in real time. Calling `session/read`, `session/list`, or resume results also shows `resumedByClient` to record who reconnected last. When starting a new conversation via `session/start`, you can pass `previousSessionId` to record which old conversation it replaces. If a main conversation opens a background worker, related lists and the `muse session-message list --json` command also attach a `spawnedBy` tag, so every row tells you which session opened that background worker.

items.original:
`session/read` shows which connected client currently drives a session (`driveHolder`, the holder's `initialize` name and version; absent when nobody live holds it)
`session/read`, `session/list` and the `session/resume` result show which client last resumed a session over the wire (`resumedByClient`, the resuming connection's `initialize` name and version, recorded durably on the resume marker)
`session/start` accepts an optional `previousSessionId` that records which session the new one replaces, even when that session no longer exists
`session/list`, `session/read` and the `session/resume` result show which session opened a worker session (`spawnedBy`: the opening session's id plus optional project and thread labels, recorded once when the worker's first session starts)
`session/start` accepts an optional `spawnedBy` (the opening session's id plus optional project and thread labels); the host records it once as the new session's opener and serves it back as `spawnedBy` on `session/list`, `session/read` and `session/resume`
`muse session-message list --json` rows carry `spawnedBy`, the session that opened each listed worker session (its id plus optional project and thread labels), read from the same session index `session/list` serves

title.zh-TW: 權限設定檔精細管制通訊插座，審批卡片揭示判斷原因
title.en: Permission profiles finely control sockets as approval cards show judgment reasons

body.zh-TW: 執行需要存取本機服務的指令時，權限設定檔現在能針對路徑個別允許、提示或拒絕通訊插座（Unix socket）連線。⟦宛如海關檢查哨的查驗清單，以往碰上特殊貨品只能放行或扣留，現在能逐項要求出示許可，遇到疑慮時也會在申報單上打勾註記原因，杜絕隨手蓋章通關。⟧如果 Docker 插座連線被沙盒阻擋，會直接說明阻擋原因與解除方式；重啟工作階段後也會持續維持提示。在審批流程中，當審批評判員決定轉交給你裁決時，審批卡片會在指令下方加註一行簡短理由，降低反射性放行高風險操作的機率。若啟動時帶入 `--yolo` 卻受到嚴格設定檔限制，開場會明列實際生效的模式。中途切換至無限制模式時也能即時同步，沙盒內的 Linux 指令更禁止竄改 `/proc/sys` 底下的核心設定。
body.en: When running commands that need access to local services, permission profiles can now allow, prompt, or deny connections to a Unix socket (a local inter-process communication channel) per path. ⟦Think of a customs checkpoint inspection list: where special goods used to only be cleared or held, inspectors can now demand permits item by item and check off reasons on the declaration form when in doubt, preventing rubber-stamp clearance.⟧ If a Docker socket connection is blocked by the sandbox, it directly explains the reason for the block and how to lift it; prompts also persist after restarting a session. In the approval flow, when the approval judge decides to escalate to you for a ruling, the approval card adds a short line of reasoning below the command, reducing the chance of reflexively approving high-risk operations. If `--yolo` is passed at startup but restricted by a strict profile, the opening lists the mode that actually takes effect. Switching to Unrestricted mode mid-session also syncs in real time, and Linux commands inside the sandbox are prohibited from tampering with kernel settings under `/proc/sys`.

items.original:
Permission profiles can now allow, prompt for, or deny Unix-socket access per path, and a refused Docker socket connection explains the sandbox block with the way out
Startup names the effective approval mode when `--yolo` was requested but a restrictive permission profile took effect
When the approval judge escalates to you instead of deciding, the approval card now shows the judge's reason as one short line under the command, so a risky request is harder to approve by reflex
Permission profiles that prompt before socket access keep prompting after a session is reopened, and opening such a session requires the latest app version
Security: Sandboxed Linux commands can no longer rewrite kernel helper settings under `/proc/sys`, even when Muse itself runs as root
Muse is told when the permission mode changes mid-session, so it stops insisting it is still on the launch mode after switching to Unrestricted

title.zh-TW: 對話紀錄權限損壞時自動安全降級，嚴防越權執行
title.en: Automatic safe downgrade on damaged chat permission history prevents unauthorized execution

body.zh-TW: 當歷史紀錄因中斷而缺少部分權限變更時，重新開啟工作階段不再暗中丟失拒絕規則。⟦好比金融金庫的防盜鎖紀錄紙本受損，保全系統不會直接解除大門管制，而是強制切換成最高安全層級的唯讀防護，確認權限無誤前絕不放行。⟧在終端機應用中，若歷史在上次變更後遺失紀錄，系統會自動比對預設值與尚存設定檔，取兩者中範圍較嚴格者降級重設，或直接退回唯讀模式並跳出警告，無法安全重設時則拒絕喚醒。帶有 `--permission-profile` 等權限旗標的對話，若遺失紀錄會改套用明確指定的權限並作廢受損前的授權。舊版應用無法打開曾重設權限的對話，需更新後開啟。在 `muse serve` 中，若主機無法備妥自動審查員，會清楚回報審查員不可用，而非模糊的內部錯誤。
body.en: When history lacks some permission changes due to an interruption, reopening a session no longer silently drops deny rules. ⟦At a bank vault with damaged lock-log paper records, the security system does not drop gate controls; instead, it forces a switch to the highest read-only protection level and refuses entry until permissions are verified.⟧ In the terminal app, if history lost a record after the last change, the system automatically compares the default and the surviving profile, resets by downgrading to the stricter of the two, or falls back directly to read-only mode with a warning, and refuses to resume if it cannot safely reset. Conversations with permission flags such as `--permission-profile` that lost records instead apply the explicitly specified permissions and invalidate grants from before the damage. Older app versions cannot open conversations whose permissions were reset and require an update to open. In `muse serve`, if the host cannot prepare the automated reviewer, it clearly reports that the reviewer is unavailable instead of returning a vague internal error.

items.original:
An older Muse build cannot open a chat whose permissions were reset because part of its saved permission history was lost or damaged; update the app to open it (other chats are unaffected)
A session with a lost permission change now refuses to resume when its safe permission reset cannot be enforced, instead of opening with silently dropped Deny rules
`muse serve` refuses to reopen a session whose automated reviewer this host cannot prepare with the `permission_profile_reviewer_unavailable` reason instead of a generic internal error
In the terminal app, resuming a chat whose saved history lost a record after your last permission change (without a permission flag) now reopens it with a reset to the narrower of the default and your surviving profile — or to `:read-only` when the two are crossed — and a warning, instead of refusing it; a resume with no safely-resettable profile is still refused
In the terminal app, resuming a chat whose saved history lost a record with a permission flag (for example --permission-profile or --sandbox-network) now applies your chosen permissions as the `lost_record_reset` commit that drops pre-loss grants (after the reset, or in its place when the reset is not allowed), and one warning that your chosen permissions apply. A pick the retained managed pin refuses, or a reset `:read-only` cannot be shown never wider than both profiles, still refuses with no reset and no warning

title.zh-TW: 喚醒對話可自訂模型覆寫，支援最高推論力度預設全開
title.en: Resumed chats allow custom model overrides with max reasoning effort on by default

body.zh-TW: 喚醒先前封存的對話時，現在可在 `session/resume` 傳入選填的 `modelId`，直接覆寫對話原本固定的模型設定。⟦恰似專業調音台換上新音訊軌道，演出者既能為個別樂器指定專屬效果器，又能讓主聲道預設發揮最高解析力，中途插入新設備時也能即時亮起對應旋鈕。⟧有紀錄選取模型的對話，重新載入時會精確維持你選定的模型，不再跳回預設值。支援最高推論力度的模型，若未手動指定力度，將預設直接啟用最大推論力度。設定檔列出的模型，現在可為提醒與審核另外指派獨立的背景模型。若在未登入狀態下貼上 API 金鑰，`/model` 選單會立刻列出對應的模型清單，不必重新啟動工具。
body.en: When resuming a previously archived conversation, you can now pass an optional `modelId` to `session/resume` to directly override the conversation's originally fixed model setting. ⟦Like swapping in a new audio track on a professional mixing console, performers can assign dedicated effects to individual instruments while letting the main channel deliver maximum resolution by default, and plugging in new gear mid-set lights up the corresponding knobs immediately.⟧ Conversations with a recorded model selection precisely keep your chosen model upon reload instead of jumping back to the default. Models that support maximum reasoning effort will enable maximum reasoning effort by default if no effort is manually specified. Models listed in the settings file can now assign a separate background model for reminders and reviews. If you paste an API key while logged out, the `/model` menu immediately lists the corresponding models without restarting the tool.

items.original:
`session/resume` accepts an optional `modelId` that overrides the retained model for that resume — over a stamped label or pin — and recovers an otherwise-unresolved label binding
Settings-listed models can name a separate background model for reminders and reviews
Models that support max reasoning effort now use it by default when you have not chosen an effort, including future models
Resumed sessions with a recorded selection keep the model you selected instead of switching to a default
Pasting an API key into a logged-out session now shows the contributor models in /model immediately, instead of only after a restart

title.zh-TW: 嚴格遵守輸出格式要求，複查結果濃縮為精簡回報
title.en: Strict adherence to output format requirements with condensed verification reports

body.zh-TW: 當你指定將計畫存入檔案並限制對話回覆的內容時，工具現在會老實寫入檔案，並僅依約定回傳對話內容。⟦仿照建築設計驗收的備忘錄，主要圖面整齊劃一，欄位放不下的細節轉成邊欄清單，複驗完工只需在末尾蓋上一句合格摘要，不再整份合約重複誦讀。⟧要求概覽、比較或特定格式時，回答不再硬塞置頂結論摘要，只有報告自身工作成果時才會以核心發現開頭。在表格中比較多個項目時，表格放不下的補充細節會拆成短段落或清單。給出最終回答後的二次檢查，成果只以一兩句話精要陳述，不重講整段回答。同一個對話中已回答過的問題不再重複詢問；在同一個工作階段延續開發新功能時，不會再一開始就拋出失敗的測試，且回報的瑕疵依然具備防退步測試。
body.en: When you specify saving a plan to a file and restrict what the chat reply should contain, the tool now faithfully writes to the file and returns only the agreed chat content. ⟦Following an architectural inspection memo, the main drawings stay uniform, details that do not fit in the table columns move to a sidebar list, and re-inspection sign-off only stamps a brief pass summary at the end instead of reciting the entire contract again.⟧ When you ask for an overview, comparison, or specific format, replies no longer force a top conclusion summary; only reports on the tool's own work lead with the key finding. When comparing multiple items in a table, supplementary details that do not fit in the table are split into short paragraphs or lists. A double-check after giving a final answer states the outcome concisely in a sentence or two without repeating the whole reply. Questions already answered in the same conversation are not asked again; when continuing to build new features in the same session, it no longer starts by throwing a failing test, while reported bugs still get regression tests.

items.original:
New features in a project the agent built earlier in the same session no longer start with a failing test, and reported bugs still get a regression test
When an answer compares several things in a table, the detail that does not fit the table now comes as short paragraphs or list items instead of one long block per item
When Muse Code double-checks its work after giving a final answer, it now reports the result of the check in a sentence or two instead of repeating or extending the answer
When you ask for a plan in a file and say what the chat reply should contain, Muse Code saves the plan and replies only as you asked
Overviews, explanations, comparisons, and answers in a format you asked for no longer open with a top-finding line; reports on work Muse Code did still lead with the main finding
Agent no longer repeats a question you already answered in the same conversation

title.zh-TW: 遊戲與 3D 技能導入美術分工，多輪盲審讓成像貼近參考圖
title.en: Game and 3D skills add art direction and multi-round blind reviews for closer renders

body.zh-TW: 透過完整企劃書製作遊戲時，內建的 `browser-game` 技能現在會分派美術總監子代理，邊寫程式邊產出素材並收納於遊戲資料夾，隨後由評審進行 3 輪試玩打分。⟦猶如微型動畫製片廠，美術總監負責繪製資產，三組測試員輪番試玩評分，算圖階段更參照參考草圖多輪盲審校正，導演一喊卡便能立刻剎車停機。⟧當提供參考圖片時，Blender 技能會啟動盲審與修正迴圈，盡可能以工作流程執行，使算圖成果貼近範例。在 `game-3d-visuals` 技能執行管線期間，若輸入停止或換方向，它會停下背景階段；說「打開檔案」會直接開啟檔案而不必乾等，一般的致謝短語則讓流程正常推進。
body.en: When building a game from a complete design document, the built-in `browser-game` skill now dispatches an art-director subagent (a dedicated helper) to produce assets alongside coding and store them in the game folder, followed by 3 playtest scoring rounds by reviewers. ⟦Inside a miniature animation studio, the art director draws assets while three test groups take turns playing and scoring, and rendering runs multi-round blind reviews against reference sketches while halting immediately the moment the director yells cut.⟧ When a reference image is provided, the Blender skill starts a blind-review and fix loop, running as a workflow where possible, so renders match the example more closely. During a `game-3d-visuals` skill pipeline run, if you ask it to stop or change course, it halts the background stage; saying "open it" opens the file directly without waiting, while ordinary thank-you phrases let the flow continue normally.

items.original:
The built-in `browser-game` skill builds games from long design documents with an art-director subagent, which makes the art and ships it in the game folder while the game is built, then runs three critic rounds that play and review the game; short game requests stay light
When a task gives a reference image, the Blender skill now runs a required critic loop of blind reviews and fixes, as a workflow where available, so renders match the reference more closely
The `game-3d-visuals` skill now stops its pipeline loop when you ask it to stop, open the file or change course: "open it" opens the file (or says it is not ready yet) instead of waiting for the running stage, and a comment such as "thanks" lets the pipeline continue
When you tell the `game-3d-visuals` skill to stop or exit while its pipeline runs, it now also stops the running background stage (unless you ask it not to call any tools), and a stage that finishes after you stopped no longer starts the next one

title.zh-TW: Python 技能優先調用預編譯套件，技能清單支援模糊檢索
title.en: Python skill prioritizes prebuilt packages while skill list supports fuzzy lookup

body.zh-TW: 安裝 Python 相依套件時，`python-env` 技能現在會優先嘗試專案或使用者指定的容器映像檔、Conda 頻道或預先編譯的套件檔（wheel），避免直接從原始碼耗時編譯。⟦跟進五金材料行取貨一樣，架上有現成組件就直接領取，不必非得在工坊親自切削金屬，型錄放不下時也能報出關鍵字讓店員調貨。⟧模型自行載入的內建技能，現在會使用模型介面提供的正確名稱呼叫工具，防止因命名不一致而調用失敗。當安裝的技能數量超出啟動清單的顯示上限時，代理依然能透過名稱或說明的片段關鍵字，檢索並載入未列在首頁清單中的擴充技能。
body.en: When installing Python dependencies, the `python-env` skill now first tries a container image, Conda channel, or wheel (a ready-to-install Python package file) specified by the project or user, avoiding time-consuming compilation from source. ⟦A trip to a hardware supply store works the same way: when ready-made components sit on the shelf, you grab them instead of machining metal in the workshop, and if the catalog cannot fit everything, you call out keywords so the clerk can pull the item from stock.⟧ Built-in skills loaded by the model on its own now call tools using the exact names offered by the model interface, preventing invocation failures from naming mismatches. When the number of installed skills exceeds the startup list display limit, the agent can still look up and load extension skills omitted from the main list using partial keywords from their name or description.

items.original:
The built-in `python-env` skill tries a container image, conda channel or prebuilt wheels that the user or the project names before compiling a dependency from source
Built-in skills the model loads on its own now name tools the way the model is offered them, so it calls them by the right name
When more skills are installed than the startup skill list can show, the agent can still find the ones left out by looking one up with part of its name or description

title.zh-TW: 恢復原生 MP4 與 MOV 影片讀取，多媒體工作階段標題更易辨識
title.en: Native MP4 and MOV video reading restored with clearer multimedia session titles

body.zh-TW: 當你將影像或影音檔案交給模型分析時，支援的模型現在恢復直接讀取原生 MP4 與 MOV 格式影片。⟦看齊放映室的播映系統，只要放映機能解碼就直接播放膠捲，中途換成不支援影像的設備也不會卡死，片名更直接採用放映標題而非報關單據。⟧即使先前讀取過影片，後續切換到不支援影片的模型、提供者或停用影像設定，工作階段依然能正常延續而不被阻擋。由外部應用程式開立對話時，其標題與首則提示預覽會直接採用使用者看見的提示文字，不再出現整段原始 JSON 資料；以技能或純圖片開場的對話，也會以具體顯示文字或 `[Image 1]` 命名。
body.en: When you pass image or video files to a model for analysis, supported models now resume directly reading native MP4 and MOV videos. ⟦Matching a screening room's projection system, the projector plays the film reel directly whenever it can decode it, switching mid-show to equipment without video support never stalls playback, and the marquee uses the actual movie title rather than customs paperwork.⟧ Even if a video was read earlier, switching later to a model, provider, or setting that does not support video lets the session continue normally without being blocked. When an external app starts a conversation, its title and first-prompt preview directly use the prompt text as shown to the user instead of displaying raw JSON blocks; conversations starting with a skill or image-only input are also named with their display text or `[Image 1]`.

items.original:
Restore native MP4 and MOV video reading for supported models
Sessions with an earlier video read keep working when the current model, provider or video setting can't send that video
A session started by another app now takes its title and first-prompt preview from the prompt as it was shown, not the app's wrapper text, so it no longer appears with raw JSON as its name; a session that starts with a skill or image is titled by its display form (its typed form, or [Image 1] for an image-only start)

title.zh-TW: 支援刪除工作樹自動重建，修復 tmux 狀態回報與 Windows 終端體驗
title.en: Deleted worktrees rebuild automatically alongside tmux status and Windows terminal fixes

body.zh-TW: 當你喚醒先前工作階段卻發現工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）已被刪除時，只要來源儲存庫已受信任，即使主機沒有可強制執行的建立沙盒，也會自動重新建立該工作樹；未受信任的儲存庫仍會拒絕。⟦如同野外工作站重啟設備，若既有分支遭意外移除，只要母基地受信任就會就地重新搭建，控制台狀態燈號也會即時同步給遠端監視器。⟧在 tmux 環境中，工具能主動廣播運作狀態，方便外部終端掌握進度。在 Windows 系統中，沙盒指令在使用者資料夾內會正確將工作區當作起點，相對路徑不再誤對應至安裝目錄；傳統主控台中按 Ctrl+V 能正常貼上文字，對話分支時也不再出現寫入錯誤。執行 `/feedback` 回報問題時，畫面會預先標註工作階段紀錄容量與修剪提示。
body.en: When you resume a prior session and find its worktree (a Git feature that lets one project keep multiple parallel working copies) was deleted, it automatically recreates that worktree as long as the source repository is already trusted, even on hosts without an enforceable creation sandbox; untrusted repositories still refuse. ⟦Restarting gear at a field station works much the same way: if an existing outpost was accidentally removed, it is rebuilt on the spot as long as the home base is trusted, and console status lights sync immediately to remote monitors.⟧ Inside tmux, the tool proactively broadcasts its running status so external terminals can track progress. On Windows, sandboxed commands inside your user folder properly start in the workspace so relative paths no longer misresolve to the install directory; pressing Ctrl+V in classic consoles pastes text normally, and branching a conversation no longer hits write errors. When running `/feedback` to report an issue, the screen previews the session record size and notes when it will be trimmed.

items.original:
Inside tmux, Muse now reports its program status (OSC 7501) without waiting for the terminal to answer, so iTerm2's tmux integration (`tmux -CC`) shows whether a session is working, waiting for you, or done; a client that attaches later sees it once the attach resizes the window or the status next changes
`/feedback` shows how big the session record is before you agree to attach it, and notes when it will be trimmed
On Windows, sandboxed shell commands now start in the workspace when it is inside your user folder, so relative paths no longer resolve under the PowerShell install folder
On Windows, Ctrl+V pastes copied text into the prompt in consoles that pass the key to Muse, such as the classic PowerShell window, instead of reporting that no image could be attached
Resuming a session whose worktree was deleted now recreates it on hosts without an enforceable creation sandbox when you already trust the source repository; untrusted repositories still refuse
Branching a conversation on Windows no longer fails with a write error

title.zh-TW: 伺服模式預設集支援持久生效，詳細回報對話分支錯誤
title.en: Server mode presets persist across logins with detailed conversation branching errors

body.zh-TW: 以伺服端架構部署背景服務時，`muse serve --preset` 現在能完整套用預設集的提示詞與執行環境設定。⟦恰如郵件伺服器的派工設定，開機時指定好投遞範本與過濾規則，登入後依然貫徹到底，若派送信件失敗也會寫明卡在哪個路徑與系統代碼，不再只丟下一句傳送失敗。⟧除了支援由 `-c` 載入的自訂設定外，啟動時選定的預設集在使用者登入後也會持續保留。當透過 `muse serve` 分支對話因工作階段檔案寫入失敗而中斷時，錯誤訊息會指明失敗的具體步驟、路徑種類及作業系統原始代碼，不再只拋出抽象字眼。在 Linux 環境下建立對話分支不再因檔案建立時間問題而碰壁。連線初始化時，若客戶端名稱超出 64 個字元將明確回絕。應用程式若遭停用，會明確回傳伺服端原因，不再盲目要求重新登入。
body.en: When deploying background services with a server architecture, `muse serve --preset` now fully applies the preset's prompts and runtime environment settings. ⟦Imagine a mail server's dispatch configuration: delivery templates and filtering rules set at boot stay enforced after login, and any failed delivery spells out the exact path and system code where it stalled instead of merely saying send failed.⟧ In addition to supporting custom configs loaded via `-c`, the preset chosen at startup persists after user login. When branching a conversation via `muse serve` fails because a session file could not be written, the error message names the specific failed step, path kind, and raw operating-system error code instead of throwing only a vague label. Creating a conversation branch on Linux no longer hits file birth time errors. During connection initialization, a client name exceeding 64 characters is explicitly rejected. If the app is deactivated, it clearly returns the server reason instead of blindly prompting to log in again.

items.original:
`muse serve --preset` applies the preset's prompts and run settings, accepts presets defined with `-c`, and keeps the preset chosen at startup after login
When branching a conversation through `muse serve` fails because a session file could not be written, the error now names the step that failed, the kind of path and the operating-system error instead of only `WriteFailed`
`initialize` now refuses a `clientInfo.name` longer than 64 characters, with the same `invalidParams` error a malformed name already gets
Forking a chat with `muse serve` on Linux works again instead of failing with "file birth time is unavailable"
A deactivated Muse Code app now names the server reason instead of telling the user to log in again

title.zh-TW: 伺服端異常中斷安全復原，未完操作不再私自執行
title.en: Safe server crash recovery stops unfinished actions from running on their own

body.zh-TW: 伺服器若無預警當機重開，先前的未竟事務現在能安全清理。⟦就像工廠控制台在跳電重啟後，先前掛在半空中的加工指令一律先重設關閉，不會擅自動手運轉機台，新進的交接事項也會確實送達值班人員手中。⟧在 `muse serve` 異常退出後喚醒工作階段，中斷前正在執行的任務不會再顯示為進行中。對於當機前等待審批的工具呼叫，重啟後不會重複彈出詢問，更不會私自逕行執行；中斷的呼叫會直接結案，模型再次調用時才走正常審批。協調通道喚醒後若畫面需要時間重繪，交接摘要與回答依然能確實送達，不再陷入沉寂。若在運作期間刪除 `session-index.db` 索引檔，清單不會損壞或崩潰，會以現有檔案重新建立。透過工作階段協定建立旁軌對話時，也不再偶發回報對話已被占用。
body.en: When the server crashes and restarts unexpectedly, any unfinished work from before is now cleaned up safely. ⟦A factory console after a power trip resets and cancels any mid-air machining commands on restart instead of running the equipment on its own, while new handover notes still reach the on-duty operator.⟧ Resuming a session after `muse serve` exits unexpectedly no longer shows tasks from the interrupted run as still in progress. Tool calls that were waiting for approval before the crash no longer prompt again or run on their own after a restart; interrupted calls are closed out and go through normal approval only if the model invokes them again. When a coordinator lane takes a moment to redraw after waking, its handover brief and answers still arrive reliably instead of going silent. Deleting the `session-index.db` index file while running no longer breaks the list or crashes the app, and the index is rebuilt from existing files. Opening a side chat over the session protocol also no longer intermittently reports that the session is already in use.

items.original:
Resuming a `muse serve` session after Muse Code exited unexpectedly no longer shows the interrupted run's work as still in progress
After a crash, `muse serve` no longer asks again about tool calls that were waiting for approval and no longer runs an approved call by itself; the interrupted calls are closed and a call the model makes again gets the normal permission check
A resumed coordinator lane whose session takes a moment to redraw now still receives its handover brief and answers, instead of going silent
Deleting `session-index.db` while Muse Code runs no longer makes the session list fail or crashes the app; the index is rebuilt with fresh files
Opening a side chat over the session protocol no longer intermittently reports the new session is already in use

title.zh-TW: 工作流程強化中斷復原，正確釋放未用容量保留
title.en: Stronger Workflow crash recovery releases unused capacity reservations

body.zh-TW: 長時間跑自動化工作流程（Workflow）時，中斷後的接續與資源管理更為嚴密。⟦宛如自動化物流倉儲的軌道調度，搬運車遇到故障重開機時會主動退還佔用的通道額度，按下暫停鈕後立刻凍結動作，絕不會在停機後又偷偷吐出貨物。⟧在流程執行當下關閉應用程式或 `muse serve`，重新開啟後會重新儲存歷史紀錄。更正遺失的流程名稱後，背景工作狀態在重啟後依然保留；若在流程剛好完工時按下暫停，狀態會老實保持暫停，不再多報完工。重啟後復原的子流程會自動釋放未使用的容量保留，發生衝突時給出清晰的重啟錯誤；以相同指令識別碼重試跳過或執行時會返回原結果。在 Windows 上已儲存的工作流程能正常自本機指令稿路徑執行，舊版工作階段不再提供流程功能，建議建立新工作階段使用。
body.en: Long-running automated Workflows now handle resumption and resource management more tightly after an interruption. ⟦Automated warehouse rail dispatch works the same way: when a shuttle faults and reboots, it gives back its reserved lane quota, and pressing pause freezes motion immediately so nothing slips out after a stop.⟧ Closing the app or `muse serve` while a Workflow is running now saves history again once reopened. After correcting a missing Workflow name, background work status survives a restart, and pausing a Workflow right as it finishes keeps its status paused without also reporting completion. Child Workflows recovered after a restart automatically release unused capacity reservations and return a clear restart error on conflicts, while retrying a skip or run with the same command ID returns the original result. Saved Workflows run properly from local script paths on Windows, and older sessions no longer offer Workflow support, so starting a new session is recommended.

items.original:
Resuming a session saved by an older version no longer offers Workflow; start a new session to use it
Background work status survives a restart after correcting a missing Workflow name
A chat in the app or `muse serve` that was closed while a workflow was running saves its history again after it is reopened
A Workflow paused just as it finishes now stays paused, instead of also reporting a finished result after the pause
Saved Workflows can run again from their local script paths on Windows
Retrying a workflow child skip or retry with the same command id after a restart returns its original result; chats whose checkpoint holds such a result require a compatible app update, and older versions cannot open them
Recovered Workflow children release unused capacity reservations, and conflicting attempts get a clear restart error

title.zh-TW: 要求主代理閱讀完整流程報告，保留長篇背景工作復原指引
title.en: Main agent reads full Workflow reports and keeps long-run recovery guidance

body.zh-TW: 當工作流程產出長篇報告時，若預覽畫面被系統自動縮短，主代理現在會先被要求調閱完整的報告內容，再對你做出回答。⟦好比專案負責人審閱結案簡報，目錄頁雖然只放精簡要點，但拍板定案前必須調閱完整附件，突發狀況的排除步驟也整頁留存，不會因為頁面摺疊而遺漏。⟧即使預覽經過裁減，完整的工作流程報告依然維持可讀性，長篇背景工作結果中的錯誤復原指引也會完整保留。遇到未知的流程結果引用時保持原樣不變；修正了指令與當前工作階段不符的問題。若工作流程中的代理經歷頻繁跳過或重試超過 128 次，工作階段在壓縮歷史後仍會正常存檔，確保後續隨時能從該檢查點接續。
body.en: When a Workflow produces a long report whose preview is shortened automatically, the main agent is now instructed to read the full report before answering you. ⟦Much like a project lead reviewing a closing deck, the summary slide shows only highlights, yet the full appendix is pulled before making a call and troubleshooting steps stay intact on their own page instead of getting lost in collapsed sections.⟧ Complete Workflow reports remain readable even when their preview is trimmed, and error recovery guidance in long background results stays intact. Unknown Workflow result references are left unchanged, and a mismatch between instructions and the current session has been fixed. If agents in a Workflow are skipped or retried more than 128 times, the session still saves its history after compaction so you can resume from that checkpoint anytime.

items.original:
Fixed workflow instructions that did not match the current session
A session saves its history again when it compacts after a Workflow's agents were skipped or retried more than 128 times, so it can be resumed from that point
Keep unknown Workflow result references unchanged
Complete Workflow reports remain readable when their preview is shortened
Keep recovery guidance intact in long background Workflow results
Tell the main agent to read complete Workflow reports before answering from a shortened preview

title.zh-TW: 背景工作完成即時喚醒對話，狀態清單精簡識別碼
title.en: Finished background tasks wake chats immediately with cleaner status IDs

body.zh-TW: 當主對話正在等待耗時的背景工作時，現在背景任務一旦完成或產出資料，就會立刻自動喚醒等待中的工作階段，不必等你手動輸入打斷。⟦猶如餐廳後廚完成特製餐點，取餐鈴響起時前台立刻主動通知顧客，不必等客人親自走到櫃台詢問，螢幕看板也只顯示簡短取餐號碼，不再塞滿長串內部訂單條碼。⟧即使早先的喚醒訊號偶發遺失，完工事件依然能成功促發喚醒。從 `/tasks` 停止剛好完成的背景工作或監視器時，會立刻登記停止，不再空等 30 秒後被拋棄。查詢工作狀態時，標題與卡片僅顯示一次短識別碼，清單優先展示項目標籤而非原始 JSON。即便背景指令遭遇紀錄錯誤，其執行結果仍會保留在歷史中；跨越多次歷史壓縮持續運作的背景任務，重新開啟對話時也不會被誤判為無效。
body.en: When the main chat is waiting on a long background task, the waiting session now wakes automatically as soon as the task finishes or produces output, without waiting for your manual input. ⟦Once a restaurant kitchen finishes a special order, the pager buzzes so the counter alerts the guest right away instead of making them walk up to ask, and the display board shows only a short pickup number rather than a long internal order barcode.⟧ Even if an earlier wake signal is lost, the completion event still triggers a wake. Stopping a background task or monitor from `/tasks` right as it finishes now records the stop immediately instead of dropping it after a 30-second wait. Work status checks show a short ID once across the header and card, and listings prefer item labels over raw JSON. Background command results stay in history even after a recording error, and background tasks that keep running across multiple compactions are no longer marked invalid when you reopen the chat.

items.original:
A session waiting on a finished background task now wakes when the task finishes instead of staying stuck until you intervene
Stopping a background task or Monitor from `/tasks` just as it finishes now records the stop right away instead of dropping it after a 30-second wait
Background task output now wakes a waiting session instead of staying queued until you intervene
A finished background task now wakes a waiting session even when an earlier wake was lost
Work status checks now show a short work ID once instead of repeating the full ID in the header and the status card, and listing background work shows item labels when present (else a short work ID) instead of raw JSON
Preserve background command results in session history after a recording error
A background task that keeps running through several compactions no longer shows as invalid after you reopen the chat

title.zh-TW: 父代理支援讀取子代理完整回覆，終止任務確實等待背景清理
title.en: Parent agents read full subagent replies and wait for background cleanup

body.zh-TW: 母代理調用子代理處理獨立工作時，現在可以直接讀取子代理完整的最終回答。⟦就像專案主管調閱外派調查員的調查手冊，現在能一次看完整本報告，不必為了閱讀後半段又派出第二位助理，收到撤隊指令時也必須等現場人員確實撤離才能回報結案。⟧以前系統只能讀取前 512 個字元，常導致母代理為了讀取剩餘內容而無端增開額外代理。當取消、強制封裝或停止仍在清理背景工作的子代理時，不會再提早虛報完畢，取消會等背景結束才回報，停止期間會明確回應正在停止中。子代理執行失敗時會忠實保留具體錯誤原因；重啟子代理對話時能保留早先產生的回覆；當機後復原的客戶端不會將已收尾的子代理顯示為執行中，並將編輯區標為唯讀以防送出被拒請求。
body.en: When a parent agent delegates independent work to a subagent, it can now read the subagent's entire final reply directly. ⟦Rather than sending a second assistant just to fetch the back half of a field investigator's notebook, a project manager can read the whole report at once, and a stand-down order closes out only after the field team has actually cleared out.⟧ Previously only the first 512 characters were readable, which often caused parent agents to spawn extra agents just to read the rest. Cancelling, force-sealing, or stopping a subagent that is still cleaning up background work no longer reports done early; cancel waits for background work to finish, and stop explicitly reports that it is stopping in the meantime. Subagent failures preserve the specific error reason, reopening a subagent chat keeps earlier replies, and a client recovered after a crash no longer shows finished subagents as running while marking the composer read-only to prevent rejected sends.

items.original:
Cancelling, force-sealing or stopping a subagent whose own background work is still being killed no longer reports it done early: the result arrives once that work has ended, a cancel that cannot finish yet fails with a typed error naming the task, a stop answers `stopping` until then and is recorded once the jobs are dead
Preserve the specific failure reason when a subagent fails
Reopening a subagent chat keeps replies from earlier work
A parent agent can now read a subagent's whole final answer instead of only its first 512 characters, so it no longer spawns extra agents just to read the rest
After a crash, a resumed client's subagent rows no longer show a recovered child as running, and its child-view composer correctly reports the thread as read-only instead of attempting a send the host rejects

title.zh-TW: 強化子代理跨重啟連線與歸屬權限，長目標對話壓縮更輕快
title.en: Subagents stay connected across restarts with lighter goal compaction

body.zh-TW: 執行需要分派子代理的長篇 `/goal` 對話時，重啟檢查點不再背負開工以來的所有瑣碎步驟，體積更小且喚醒更迅速。⟦恰如工地現場的班長名冊，即使總部重啟或工作日誌重新裝訂，派駐在各區的工班隊長依然保有完整的聯絡管道與指揮權，交班紀錄也不用把開工第一天的大小瑣事全數背在身上。⟧在對話經過壓縮後，向先前啟動的子代理指派後續任務或等待回應，不會再因執行過 Shell 指令或缺少所有權而回報失蹤。由 `/goal` 啟動的子代理在自我壓縮時會正確存檔以供接續；因重啟中斷的子代理通訊紀錄，會在母對話喚醒時自動重讀。在配置 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的環境下，伺服器重啟前完成的子代理能順利接收後續任務；使用 `tbh exec --session-id` 喚醒對話時，也不會再弄丟子代理關聯。
body.en: In long `/goal` sessions that dispatch subagents, restart checkpoints no longer carry every minor step from the start, making them smaller and faster to wake. ⟦Compare it to a construction site foreman roster: even if headquarters restarts or the site log is rebound, section leads keep their communication lines and authority intact without hauling every tiny detail from day one in the handover notes.⟧ After a conversation is compacted, sending follow-up tasks to or waiting on previously started subagents no longer reports them missing due to prior shell commands or missing ownership. Subagents started from `/goal` save properly when self-compacting so they can resume, and subagent transcripts cut off by a restart are reread automatically when the parent chat wakes. With MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) configured, subagents that finished before a server restart can receive follow-up tasks smoothly, and waking a chat with `tbh exec --session-id` no longer drops subagent links.

items.original:
Long `/goal` sessions that start sub-agents keep their resume checkpoints small and resume quickly, instead of carrying every step since the first sub-agent started
A follow-up task sent to a subagent that finished before `muse serve` restarted no longer stops before reaching the model when MCP servers are configured
A sub-agent started from a `/goal` chat saves its history again when it compacts, so it can be resumed from that point
After resuming a compacted session, follow-ups and waits on a subagent no longer fail once a shell command ran after the compaction
A subagent's transcript that a restart cut off reads again as soon as its parent session resumes, with no action on the subagent
Resuming a compacted session with `tbh exec --session-id` keeps its subagents, so following up with, waiting on or checking a subagent no longer reports it missing
After a resumed session, following up with a subagent started before the conversation was compacted works again instead of failing the subagent with a missing ownership error

title.zh-TW: 歷史壓縮完整保留常駐指令，折疊早期紀錄避免重複重播
title.en: Compaction preserves standing duties verbatim and collapses older history

body.zh-TW: 對話太長觸發上下文壓縮時，交接摘要現在會逐字保留常駐待命的操作觸發條件與完整指令，例如「獲得審批即刻啟動機器人」，防止關鍵指令在摘要過程中被淡化忽略。⟦仿照航海日誌的階段性結算，舊航程濃縮成單一封存捲軸，但遇敵反擊的標準作業準則逐字抄寫在現役手冊上，不必每翻一頁就重複推敲前文。⟧透過 `muse serve` 重新開啟壓縮後的工作階段，早期歷史會整齊收納為單一折疊項目，不認識該項目的客戶端會顯示備援文字，後面直接銜接最新進展，不再從頭重播一遍。超長工作階段壓縮時不再卡死；背景摘要若失敗或容量超標，系統不會每輪白花額度重算，改等內容明顯增長後才再次嘗試。若技能內容在壓縮時被帶走，提醒機制會在有需要時重新提供該技能，自動備忘錄也不再重複抄錄使用者訊息。
body.en: When a long conversation triggers context compaction, handover summaries now keep standing operational triggers and exact commands verbatim—such as starting a bot once approval arrives—so key instructions are not watered down or overlooked. ⟦A ship's log settles each leg the same way: past voyages are rolled into a single archive scroll, while standard combat procedures are copied word for word into the active manual so nobody has to re-read earlier pages on every turn.⟧ Reopening a compacted session through `muse serve` neatly folds earlier history into a single collapsed item—clients that do not recognize it display fallback text—followed directly by recent progress instead of replaying from the beginning. Very long sessions no longer stall during compaction, and if a background summary fails or exceeds capacity, the system stops spending quota every turn and waits until the conversation grows noticeably before retrying. If a skill's content is summarized away during compaction, the reminder offers that skill again when needed, and automatic history notes no longer copy preserved user messages repeatedly.

items.original:
